summary: Tests-only PR: expanded URLProtocol coverage using published provider response shapes. swift is unavailable in this container, so the Swift suite could not run.

references.result: Generated OpenAPI dependencies and a pinned document are not present in this tests-only change.
Stubbed manifest, recent-sheet, capture, measurement, and judgment paths are covered; the generated client and ranked-results operation are not implemented.
Hand-written API models remain during the test-writing phase.
Tests use MockURLProtocol and do not need a live server; execution was blocked because swift is not installed.
Records provider commit evidence, contract deltas, and the manifest/ranked-results schema gaps.
